Thanks for the details — confirming availability and SOP. Posted below per your request.

-- Airport Limo Standard VIP Handoff SOP --
1) Driver monitors flight ETA and calls scheduled point 30 minutes prior to arrival.
2) Driver will park at the curb and call the Redwood ops cell (+1 415-555-0199).
3) Onsite Redwood escort (badge required) will meet driver curbside for guest transfer; driver remains with vehicle for valet/staging handoff.
4) All VIP pickups include a printed manifest with guest name, arrival time, and phone number. Driver presents manifest to onsite Redwood rep on request.
5) If staging is required, driver proceeds to Skyline Lot B and radios operations dispatch; shuttle transfers guests to venue (shuttle included in staging quote).

Quoted line-items:
- 2x Sedan airport pickups (09:00–10:30 window): $1,150 total (includes tolls, driver wait time)
- Staging + shuttle package (Lot B, 4-hour block): $520 (permits + shuttle)
- Printed manifest and driver liaison fee: $45

Total (suggested billable to Redwood / Acme split): $1,715

We will provide a single invoice to Redwood with an optional bill-to for Acme Events. Confirm billing preference and any insurance rider needed for on-lot staging.
